about: The links the progress page needs that the kernel's own files do not hold. (1) operations: the board pieces that are an operation a program would call, by the families of the catalogue in chapter 10.2, each with a short plain name; every other piece is a building block, a format, a check or a decision, and is counted only in the phase view. (2) wrapper: the board piece each of geom-solidcore's operations stands for, so each stored case in geom-solidcore/tests/cases.json is a case of that piece (a case may also be linked one by one in case_pieces). (3) waiting: the measured building and family cases (decision 32.70, ids bldg-NN by their row in the measuring table) that are not in cases.json because the wrapper has no operation to make them yet, each with what it waits for and the piece it is a case of. A case that is in cases.json is never counted as waiting, whatever this file says. The page lists any case linked to no piece.
